_notes: Commissary garages (design: Commissary and new foods). Keys starting with an underscore are notes; the loader ignores them.
_commissaries: Each is a garage in an industrial or mixed block, picked from tools/balance/city.json. A new game gives random AI shops to retail and office units and a rival's factory to a few random warehouses, and never a business to a home (the game's CityGenerator, 1.0). So a commissary is a warehouse, or a residential building where the neighbourhood has no warehouse: Hell's Kitchen's is First Street 22, by the wholesaler at First Street 18 (10 October 2026; First Street 24, a retail unit, held a liquor store in one game and a nightclub in another). A rival factory can still land in one of the warehouses; the log says so at load, and the bay works the same. Changing an address is safe for saves: they keep only the id. id is lower-case letters, digits and dashes and is part of the commissary's phone contact (foodtrucks-commissary-<id>, which en.json names). name is a locale key. address is street#number. The loading bay is the kerb by the building's nearest entrance; a vehicle within rules.json's commissary.bayRadiusMetres of it stands in the bay. An optional bay {x, z} (world metres, as Ctrl+F8 logs them) moves the bay to a measured point, for a garage whose entrance faces a no-parking kerb. Positions are approximate until checked in game.
